bio.text: Rick Crosson, a Democrat, won the August 2026 Democratic primary for Wisconsin's 8th Congressional District, according to the Wisconsin Examiner's primary voter guide, which marks him as the winning candidate and describes him as 68 years old.
He is a retired U.S. Army lieutenant colonel originally from Georgia who lives in Green Bay, and he sits on the Business Advisory Council at the University of Wisconsin-Stevens Point.
